tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pas mdzad pa'i bdag bskyed sgrub thabs kyi 'bru non brjed tho tsam zhig bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti sid dhaṃ/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dus gsum rgyal ba yi/ /ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa'i ye shes kun/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam dpal khro bo'i sku/ / bcom ldan bhai ra wa yis dge legs stsol/ / 'dir mnyam med yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa'i snying po ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin la/ de la yang rgyud sde'i dbye ba gnyis dang*/ gsum dang*/ bzhi dang*/ lnga dang*/ drug sogs dbye ba mang du yod pa las/ 'dir bshad par bya ba ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa yin/ 'di la yang pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis las/ pha rgyud yin zhing*/ pha rgyud la rigs lnga'am 'dod chags zhe sdang dang gti mug gi rgyud gsum thabs rgyud kyi dbye ba yin/ zhes dang*/ de la 'dir bshad par bya ba ni/ zhe sdang gshin rje gshed kyi rgyud yin pas/ de la'ang dmar nag 'jigs gsum las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed ces bya ba yin la/ de la yang rwa skyo gnyos sogs lugs srol mang du yod pa las/ ches mchog tu gyur pa'i byin rlabs kyis gzi byin dang ldan pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs zhes phyogs thams cad du nyi zla ltar grags pa 'di la/ dam pa gong ma'i sgrubs thabs mang du mdzad mod/ 'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas sgrol ba'i mgon po 'khor lo sdom pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs/ rgyas 'bring bsdus pa dang gsum las/ rgyas pa 'bar ba zhes bya ba slob ma'i dbang dang mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i thabs dang 'brel ba'i/ gzhal yas khang gtso 'khor ro langs chen po brgyad dang bcas shing phyag mtshan sogs sgom pa gcig dang*/ rang gi rgyun gyi nyams len la sgrub thabs snying po/ /blo dman nyer 'tsho zhes bya ba gtso rkyang zhal phyag yongs rdzogs dang*/ thod ra khrag mtsho bsrung 'khor chos 'byung dang bcas pa sgom pa gnyis yod pa las/ sgrub thabs snying po'i 'bru non brjed tho tsam zhig

/dam pa'i gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin bri bar bya'o/ /'dir chos tshul 'di spyan 'dren mkhan gyi slob dpon/ spyan ji ltar drangs tshul/ lugs srol ji ltar byung tshul sogs rgyas par dam pa'i mchog gi zur na mdzad yod der blta bar bya'o/ /de la sgrub thabs 'di 'chad pa las/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis so/ /thun mong la gnas dang gdan bshad pa/ gsum las skyabs su 'gro ba/ sems bskyed pa/ rdor sems sgom bzlas kyi rgyud sbyang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dur khrod la sogs pa dbugs bral gyi gdan la 'dug ste 'di skad do/ /zhes gsungs pas/ dur zhes pa ro dang*/ khrod zhes pa ro'i dkyil la 'dug ste dbugs dang bral ba ro'i gdan zhes pa ste/ rgya gar sogs na ro gdan dngos su byed pa'ang yod cing*/ rang nyid kyi de lta bu dang ldan pas/ dur khrod du gnas pa ni/ dgongs pa yin pas mchog tu legs la/ yang ci bde bar gnas pa'i tshe/ dmigs pas sa phyogs thams cad dur khrod kyis khyab cing*/ mi ro'i gdan la 'dug par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyabs yul 'di ltar du gsal btab ste/ de yang skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul dkon mchog gsum/ dus ji tsam sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du 'gro ba/ bdag dang sems can thams cad do/ /de yang rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ mtshan dang dpe byad sogs kyis spras pa zhig lam gyis sgom zhing*/ bla ma'i g.yas g.yon dang mdun du gdan khri sgom pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ cung zad kyis dma' ba mdun gyi gdan la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/

g.yon gyi gdan la rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rang rgyal dang*/ nyan thos sogs theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun rnams dang*/ g.yas kyi gdan la dam pa'i chos rnam pa glegs bam brag ri lta bu/ gdong dar thams cad rang la bstan pa ste/ khra shig ge ba dang*/ gzhan yang steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ bar gyi cha la yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ 'og gi cha la mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams sprin dpung 'khrigs pa ltar bzhugs par mos la/ skyabs 'gro bya zhing 'dir rgyud bla mar yi dam chos skyong sogs gsal kha med kyang de ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /yang rnam pa gcig tu ni/ de thams cad khrom tshogs su bzhugs par bsgoms pas rung zhing*/ bsdus na skyabs yul kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma yin te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi zhes sogs kyis sangs rgyas kun 'dus bstan cing chos kyi phung po sogs kyis dam pa'i chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yin pa'i phyir chos kun 'dus dang*/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi zhes sogs kyis don dam pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yin la/ rnam pa ni theg pa che chung gi dge 'dun thams cad kyi dpon nam gtso bo'am bdag po lta bur gyur pas dge 'dun kun 'dus rgyud par bcas pas zhes pas rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus yin pas/ rgyud pa'i bla ma smos mi dgos la/ 'on kyang rdo rje 'chang nas legs par brgyud pa'i gdams pa zab mo kun rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dus pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus so/ /de yang rgyud bla las/ thub pa chos kyi sku can phyir/ /tshogs kyang de'i mthar thug phyir/ /zhes sogs/ de ltar skyabs yul de nyid la blau ling gis bkal te/ skyid sdug legs nyes ji ltar yang khyed rang mkhyen snyam pa'i sgo nas/ skyabs 'gro mang nyung ji ltar rig par byas nas/ mthar skyabs yul rnams 'od du ldem gyis zhu ste rang la thim par bsam mo/

/gsum pa ni/ sems bskyed tshul bshad pa las/ dang po skyes bu rab ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa/ 'bring ni rang nyid kho na sangs rgyas 'dod pa/ tha ma ni rang nyid tshe 'dir bde ba tsam don du gnyer ba'o/ /des na 'dir skyes bu rab kyi sems bskyed la bslab dgos te/ de yang 'di ltar du bsam mo/ /nam mkha'i gar khyab ni sems can thams cad kyis khyab la/ de thams cad rang gi pha ma sha stag yin zhing 'dir bde ba la bzhag /sdug bsngal las bskyab pa zhig ste/ nam mi 'dod bzhin du sdug bsngal myong ba snying re rje na/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal las skyabs shing*/ bde ba la bzhag dgos par 'dug kyang*/ da lta rang la de lta bu'i mthu med pas de ltar mi nus shing*/ de lta bu nus pa la bdag ci nas kyang*/ sangs rgyas thob dgos pa 'dug /sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la thabs zhig dgos pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor 'di nyid nyams su blangs te sangs rgyas thob par bya snyam pa'i sgo nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs tshar gsum ngag tu brjod do/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs zhes pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ lha bsgom pa sngags bzla ba/ mnyam par 'jog pa sogs kyi don no/ /de dag ni sems bskyed kho na yin la/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs n-i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang bcas pa yin la/ 'di mdzad pa po ni kha che paṇ+ḍi ta shākya shrī nyid kyis mdzad do/ /de'i don ni 'gro ba ma lus pa ngan song las bsgral bar 'dod pas/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs zhu zhing*/ chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtogs par byed pa'i shes rab dang*/ brtse ba snying rje chen po gnyis dang ldan pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed par dam bcas pa yin la/ de lta bu'i dam bca' ba de'i dpang por su zhe na/ dkon mchog gsum mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i drung du bdag nyid gnas bca' nas brtson 'grus dang ldan pas/

rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /zhes pa ste/ skyabs sems sbrags ma 'di yang tshar gsum ngag tu brjod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ de ltar sems bskyed nas/ rang tha mal gnas pa'i spyi bor sna tshogs pad ma'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba de'i steng du hūṃ dkar po de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed pa ste/ 'di'i skabs kyi rdo rje sems dpa' ni rab tu zhi ba rin po che'i rgyan can dbu skra phyed bcings/ lhag ma dpung pa'i steng na si li bun ne ba dang*/ dar gyi na bza' sogs sgrub thabs bzhin du bskyed pa yin zhing*/ sngags yang*/ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya zhes sogs shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes pa'i sngags kyi rdor sems ni he ru ka ste/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ dbu skra yang ral pa'i thor tshugs chen po ste dbu skra'i rtse sogs sil bu yin kyang*/ 'dus par thor tshugs kyi nang du chud pa zhig go/ yum ni rang mtshungs zhes pa la don dam par ngo bo la dbye ba med cing tha dad du med kyang rnam par na tha dad pa'i tshul gyis 'khyud pa yin cing*/ rgyan sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams yab dang*/ mtshungs su bshad pa yin no/ /rang snang zhes pa rnams la/ yab rang nyid kyi sku'i 'od zer yum gyi rnam par gyur nas 'khyud pa yin zhes mkhas pa rnams kyi bzhed pa yin/ de lta bu'i yab yum dam ye dbye ba med pa de nyid lam gyis gsal btab pa'i dbu skra phyed bcings kyi mdun/ rin po che'i prog zhu'i nang du rigs kyi bdag po mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i rdor sems de nyid kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje/ mgrin par āḥdamar po gsung rdo rje/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po thugs rdo rje/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig gi mtha' skor du sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba gsal btab cing*/

yig 'bru thams cad kha dog dkar po'o/ /de nas spyi bor rdo rje sems dpa' la bcom ldan 'das zhes bos nas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i zhes pa nas/ mdzad du gsol gyi bar de de yang sdig pa zhes bya ba mi dge ba bcu dang*/ sgrib pa zhes pa sogs thar sogs kyi sdom pa rnams nyams te/ thar pa'i lam sgrib par byed pa ste/ nyes ltung thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab cing*/ bzlas dmigs 'di ltar du bya'o/ /thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sdig sgrib 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun skya khral khral byung bas/ yab kyi sku gang*/ rdo rje'i lam nas brgyud yum gyi sku lus kyang khengs te/ sbyor mtshams nas skya na ra ra byung*/ rang gi spyi bor thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad rim gyis gang*/ sdig sgrib thams cad bu ga dgu dang ba spu'i bu ga nas nag nu ru ru thon te/ sa 'og thag ring por song lus thams cad bdud rtsis skya mer re re gang*/ mthar sha rus dang bcas pa'i lus 'di nyid kyang sbrul gyis shun pa phud pa ltar dag ste/ bdud rtsi las grub pa dang bcas gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du skya khrol gyis dag pa ltar bzhin pas sngags mang nyung ci rigs pa bzlas zin pa'i na/ thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ phyag 'tshal 'dud cing zhes sogs brjod/ 'di phyag 'tshal lnga po ye shes lnga la phyag 'tshal ba ste/ 'di la don dam pa'i phyag 'tshal ba zhes bya'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa bdag sogs sems can thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du 'grub par mdzod/ ces sogs/ de nas mgon po zhes bos nas/ bdag cag ni chos dang chos min mi shes pa dang*/ ston pas gsungs pa'i chos dang*/ khyad par gsang sngags la ma gus pa dang*/ dam tshig spang blang shes bzhin du bag med par spyod pa dang*/ nyon mongs mang po'i dbang du gyur te/ spang bya bzlog pa'i dam tshig ni ma spangs pas 'gal/

bsrung bya sgrub pa'i dam tshig ni ma sgrub pa'i nyams pa'i bdag cag 'gro ba 'di dag la skyabs su gsol/ zhes ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs pa de la gsol ba drag tu gdab cing*/ slar yang rigs thams cad kyi gtso bo rdo rje 'chang thugs rje chen pos sems can ngan 'gro la thar bar mdzad pa'i gtso bo khyod la/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs zhu zhing*/ sngon chad sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad gnong 'gyod chen pos bshags par bgyid cing*/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyid pa'i/ sngon chad sdig sgrib ci bsags pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba snying thag pa nas btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par mer gyis zhu ste rang la thim pa'i/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ bsod nams tshogs bsags dang ye shes tshogs bsags gnyis/ dang po la yul dag pa la tshogs bsags pa dang*/ ma dag pa ma bsags pa gnyis las/ dang po la tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa/ phyag 'tshal ba mchod pa 'bul ba/ rgyun bshags bya rig lnga spyi dang so so'i sdom pa bzung ba rnams so/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid sngar tha mal par gnas pa de skad cig tsam gyis rdo rje 'jigs byed sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ma he'i gdong can phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba ling ga gyen du langs pa/ thod skam gyi dbu brgyan/ rlon pa'i do shal sogs/ dur khrod chas brgyad sku la rdzogs pa gsal zhing dwangs la snyog pa med pa zhig tu lam gyis gyur pa'i/ thugs kar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa lte bar ze'u 'bru'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/

hūṃ yig mthing nag 'od kyi rang bzhin can zhig bsgom la/ de'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo lcags kyu lta bu'i rnam pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas ni bcom ldan 'das 'jigs byed zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa rtsa zhal gyi thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan gyi nang*/ srin zhal lta bu'i mdun du ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam pa bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba ste/ de lta bu'i dbu rgyan du byas pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi mtha' skor du ro langs chen po brgyad/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa/ skad cig gis khra mer gyis mdun gyis nam mkhar byon par bsam la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pa'am/ yang rnam pa gcig tu na tshogs kyi zhing de dag thams cad rtag tu bzhugs bzhin pa la/ sngar las ngan pa'i bag chags 'thug pos bsgribs nas mthong bar ma gyur pa/ 'od zer des khra lam gyis mthong ba sgom par bshad de/ dper na mun khang zhig na dngos po gya nom pa yod pa de mthong bar ma gyur cing yod pa ma shes pa la/ lag tu sgron me zhig thogs te byin pa na/ dngos po de dag mthong ba dang 'dra bar sgom pa'am/ yang na 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar skad cig der khra mer gyis bzhugs 'dug par bsam ste/ 'di gsum blo ru gang 'dzom zhig sgom pa'i rung bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ dmigs pa bde na rang gi lus grangs med par sprul nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mi bde na rang rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa de kas phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zhes pas thal mo spyi bor sbyar te bla ma dang*/ na mo badz+ra bhai ra wa maṇ+ḍal/ zhes sogs kyis thal mo snying gar sbyar te yi dam 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bar mos shing*/ gang gi drin gyis zhes sogs kyis bstod pa dang bcas pa phyag 'tshal bar mos la/

de'i don spyir dam pa'i chos thams cad bde ba chen po'i ye shes skye bar byed pa'i rgyu yin yang skad cig de nyid du rtogs par mi nus/ bla ma'i drin gyis bde ba chen po'i ye shes de skad cig la 'char bar nus pa/ bla ma de nyid dgos 'dod ma lus 'byung ba 'dra ste/ rdo rje can de nyid kyi zhabs 'og gi pad+ma la'ang phyag 'tshal na/ sku dngos smos ma dgos pa yin no/ /'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab nang gnas pa sogs kyi don ni/ 'khor ba 'dam rdzab lta bu'i nang na gnas pa'i sems can rnams thugs rje chen po'i phyag gis drangs te/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad pa'i bla ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus pa thugs rje chen po'i rang bzhin gyi slob dpon khyod la bdag cag rnams skyabs mchi'o/ /zhes pa ste de yan chad ni bla ma la phyag 'tshal ba yin la/ dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /zhes pa'i tshigs rkang gnyis pa yi dam la phyag 'tshal ba ste/ de'i don ni/ rgya gar sogs na rang gis dmod pa bor nas me tog gang la phog pa'i lha de la yi dam byed pa yod kyang*/ 'dir de ltar ma byung bas/ me tog phog pa'i lha yin snyam pa'i mos pa byed pa dang*/ me tog 'bul ba'i skabs su yang rang gang la mos pa'i lha de la phog snyam byed pa'o/ /gsum pa mchod pa ni/ sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum las/ sngags ni oṃ badz+ra la s+ya hūṃ te rdo rje sgeg mo/ phyag rgya ni sgeg pa'i phyag rgya/ ting nge 'dzin nas rang gi snying kha na lha mo sgeg pa'i phyag rgya can dpag tu med pa spros nas/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mchod pa'i mnyes par bsam/ de bzhin du badz+ra ma l+ya draṃ te/ rdo rje 'phreng ba ma me tog 'phreng ba 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ snying ga nas me tog gi 'phreng ba thogs pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang*/ badz+ra girti te rdo rje glu ma/ ngag nas glu 'byin pa'i phyag rgya dang*/

glu ma dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang*/ badz+ra nirti te rdo rje gar ma/ gar bsgyur ba'i phyag rgya/ karma dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang*/ badz+ra dhu pe te/ rdo rje bdug spos/ bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ spos sbyar thogs pa dang*/ lhan skyes sogs kyis spos snod thogs pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang*/ badz+ra puṣ+pe te/ rdo rje me tog ma/ me tog gis phyag rgya dang*/ maṇa dha ra ba ut+pal tsam pa ka sogs dang*/ rin po che'i me tog thogs pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang*/ badz+ra a lo ke dang*/ dī paṃ zhes pa rdo rje snang gsal ma ste/ mar me'i phyag rgya dang*/ snang ba gsal bar byed pa/ nyi zla rin po che dang*/ mar gyi rkong bu sogs snang ba gsal bar nus pa thogs pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa dang*/ badz+ra gan+dhe te/ rdo rje dri chab ma/ dri mchog gi phyag rgya dang*/ dung chos sogs dri bzang po btab pa'i chu thogs pa dpag tu med pas mchod pa'i mthar/ slar yang lha mo rnams rang gi snying gar bsdu'o/ /bzhi pa rgyun bshags ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar yan lag bdun par 'dod pa'i mkhas pa mang po snang la/ 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa sgrol ba'i mgon po'i lugs kyis yan lag bdun pa brtsi bar 'dod na/ gong du bstan pa'i phyag 'tshal dang*/ mchod pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pa dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /zhes pa'i tshigs gsum sdom pa skyabs 'gro dang*/ dge ba la rjes su yi rang dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung dang*/ rang gzhan don ni zhes pa nas/ byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /

zhes pa'i bar dang bcas pa sems bskyed pa dang*/ dge ba bsngo ba ste/ bdun no/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar ni rgyun bshags yan lag lnga pa zhes bya'o/ /de'i don ni/ dkon mchog gsum la byang chub ma thob bar du skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ da lta'i bar sdig pa'i las byas pa la 'gyod sems dang bcas pas bshags pa/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang mi bgyid snyam pa'i sdom sems dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams na dge ba'i rtsa bar gyur pa thams cad la rjes su yi rang zhing*/ rang nyid kyis dge rtsar gyur pa la yang sems dang ba cung zad bskyed pa ma gtogs/ ngar 'dzin bzang rlom shin tu mi legs pa'i mi bya'o/ /gzhan yang sngar rang nyid kyis bgyis pa'i dge rtsa ci lta bu la'ang*/ 'gyod sems byung na de'i 'bras bu nyams par 'gro ba dang*/ gzhan gyi dge rtsa la yi rang rnam par dag pa skyes na/ dge rtsa de'i 'bras bu rang la'ang cha shas thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung nas/ don dam byang chub kyi sems bzung ba yin la/ rang gzhan gyi don gyi mchog de nyid rab tu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ bdag gis bla na med pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed par bgyid cing*/ de lta bu'i sems bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad mgron po lta bur bya ste/ byang chub kyi spyod pa mchog gi bdud rtsis tshim par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin zhing*/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pa dge ba bsngo ba ste/ de la'ang dper na/ mi zhig gis gtor ma zhal zas bshams te/ sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin rnams med par/ gtor ma 'di thob par gyur cig /ces brjod pa tsam gyis smon sems tsam du ni 'gyur gyi thob par mi 'gyur/ thob par byed pa cho ga zhig dgos pa ltar/ rang nyid kyis kyang dge ba'i las zhig la brten te rang gzhan thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa bar gtogs pa ci dang ci bgyis pa thams cad gcig tu bsdoms te/

sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur bsngo ba'o/ /lnga pa rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba la/ rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig sdom pa dang*/ so so'i dam tshig sdom pa bzung ba gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ mchod pa'i yul thams cad bzhugs pa la/ dgongs su gsol zhes brjod nas bdag 'di zhes bgyi bas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/ 'das pa dang*/ ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sems can 'khor ba las bsgral ba'i ched du/ bdag sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i thugs bskyed pas sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig /thob par gyur la thob par mdzad pa/ de bzhin du bdag kyang sems can gyi don du byang chub thob par 'dod sems mchog de bskyed par bgyi/ zhes pa ni/ smon pa'i sems bskyed do/ /'jug pa'i sems bskyed la/ nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims so/ /dang po ni/ sngon chad sdig pa'i las byas pa la/ 'gyod sems dang*/ slan chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyid pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ dge ba'i chos thams cad ci nus ci lcogs kyis bgyid pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sems can gyis don gang la gang 'dul gyis byed pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa/ so so'i dam tshig sdom pa la/ rnam snang*/ mi bskyod pa/ rin 'byung*/ 'od dpag med/ don grub rnams kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa bzung ba la/ dang po ni/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ de'i bslab bya la slaub pa yin zhing*/ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor zhes pa ni rnam snang ngo*/ /gnyis pa ni rdo rje thugs/ dril bu gsung*/ phyag rgya sku rnams kyi dam tshig dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon rab tu gus pas bsten zhing smad par mi byed pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ chos dang zang zing dang*/ mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs dang*/ byams pa dang sbyin pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ phyi'i theg pa nyan thos rang rgyal phar phyin dang*/

nang gi theg pa rgyud sde 'og ma gsum dang*/ gsang ba'i theg pa rnal 'byor bla med kyi don nyams su len pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ gong du bshad kyi sdom pa kun dang*/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mchod pas mnyes par byed pa'o/ /de ltar byang chub kyi sems bla na med pa dang*/ sdom pa bzung bar byed pa des 'bras bu gang 'dod pa'i phyir na/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du bdag gis byang chub kyi sems bskyed cing*/ sdom pa ma lus bzung nas/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba las ma bsgral ba sgrol cing*/ sems rgyud nyon mongs pa'i bcings te/ ma grol ba rnams grol bar byed pa dang*/ lam sgrub pa'i thabs sna tshogs kyis nga rgyal te dbugs ma byung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams/ mya ngan las 'das pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bla na med pa la 'god par bya'o/ / zhes so/ /gnyis pa yul ma dag pa la tshogs bsags pa ni/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom ste/ de yang byams pa tshad med/ snying rje tshad med/ dga' ba tshad med/ btang snyoms tshad med de bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ sems can thams cad tshe 'dir bde ba dang ldan zhing*/ tshe rabs thams cad du bde ba'i rgyu dge ba rlabs po che dang ldan par gyur cig /snyams pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral zhing tshe rabs thams cad du sdug bsngal myong ba'i rgyu sdig pa'i las thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /snyams pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral zhing bde ba dang ldan pa de dang nam du'ang bral bar ma gyur cig /snyams pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sems can la nye 'gyang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig /snyams pa ste/ 'di rnams kyang kha tsam tshig tsam du ma yin pa'i zhe thag pa'i sgo nas lan gsum ngag tu brjod do/ /gnyis pa ye shes tshogs bsags ni/ kun rdzob snang grags kyi chos thams cad stong par sbyong ba yin pa la/

de la'ang sngags tshan bzhis stong par sbyong ba dang*/ gsum gyis sbyong ba dang*/ gnyis kyis sbyong ba dang*/ gcig gis sbyong ba sogs du ma zhig yod pa las/ 'dir ni bsdus pa'i tshul gyis gcig gis sbyong ba ste/ de yang bod skad du/ brjod na/ rang bzhin gyis ma dag pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i/ zhes so/ /'di la'ang kha cig sgyu ma lta bu'i 'dun par sbyong ba sogs mi 'dra ba dag snang yang*/ rang lugs ni tha mal gyi snod bcud stong par ma sbyang ba'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ma 'byung bas/ tha mal gyi snod bcud 'di dag stong pa nyid du bsgom zhing*/ gnas lugs bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba 'di bskyed gzhir bya ste/ 'ja' tshon lta bu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgom par byed pa yin no/ /de la swa bhā wa'i dag bya dag byed ni/ sbyang bya 'chi ba 'od gsal zhes pa shi nas bar do ma shar ba de sbyong bar byed pa/ 'bras bu chos sku thob par byed pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig cing*/ rdzogs rim gyi smin byed du 'gro ba dpe don gyi 'od gsal nyams myong dka' ba med par skye bar byed do/ / rtsa ba'i gnyis pa dngos gzhi sgom par byed pa la/ rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa lha bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ stong pa'i ngang las chos kyi 'byung gnas zur gsum zur gcig 'og tu bstan pas/ bzhir 'gyur yang phyaugs gang nas bltas kyang zur gsum mo/ /de yang phyi dkar pa thab nang dmar ba shes rab/ 'phel ka gyen du bstan pas yon tan gong du 'phel ba/ steng gi zur gsum nas/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa dang gsum/ 'og gi zur gcig 'dus ma byas te/ rnam par thar pa sgo bzhi'i bdag nyid can shin tu rgya che ba/ 'di'i dbyibs gtor ma zur gsum khog stong zhig gi rtse mo sa la btsugs pa 'dra ba zhig go

/de'i nang du bsrung 'khor sgom pa skabs 'dir bstan kyang*/ chos 'byung gi phyi nang gang du bsgom kyang 'gal ba med do/ / de nas chos 'byung de nyid kyi nang gi dbus su hūṃ mthing nag de yongs su gyur pa las/ sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa ste/ rwa bcu gnyis pa bsgom pa dang*/ dbal kha'i tshul du yod kyang skabs 'dir rwa nyi shu pa bstan pa yin zhing*/ dbus rwa'i g.yas g.yon du gnyis gshib steng mar bsgom par bya'o/ /dag pa bsgom par byed pa ni/ shar rwa me long lta bu'i ye shes lnga'i dag pa sbyor ba yang mi 'gal mod/ 'on kyang rwa nyi shu pa 'di ni 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri'i rtse mo mthon po nyi shu 'joms par byed pa'o/ /de lta bu'i lte ba mthing nag de'i staing du hūṃ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sna tshogs rdo rje lte ba'i steng du rdo rje sa gzhi ste/ rdo rje go mtshams med par gtams pa/ rgya che ba dbyib zlum po/ stegs sa la rdul chags pa'i rnam pa mi mngon pa rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ de'i steng gi mtha' las cung zad kyi nang du son par rdo rje'i rwa ba zlum po/ 'thug cing rgya dpang dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rdo rje'i gur 'byung ste/ kha gcig rwa ba mnan te sbrags ma'i tshul du sgom pa 'dug kyang*/ rwa lugs ni rwa gur kha sprod du sgom par byed cing*/ kha sbyar mtshams kyi nang thams cad la/ rdo rje'i bla re gru bzhi pa zhig yod pa sgom par byed pa'o/ /phy-i rol tu rdo rje'i rwa gur las steng du ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba dang 'og tu rdo rje'i sa gzhi las me dpung rab tu 'bar te/ phyogs bcu thams cad ye shes kyi mes gtams pa'o/ / badz+ra rak+ṣa zhes sogs lan gsum mam gcig brjod de/ rdo rje bsrung ba zhes pa ste brtan par byed pa'o/ /rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang 'gram nas/ khrag mtsho'i bar la/

ji skad gsungs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad shin tu rgya che ba/ de rnams kyi ro sna tshogs pa'i khrag rnams dbus su tshogs pa las/ khrag gi rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs pa/ de'i dbus su thod rwa'i gdan rin po che'i rdo rwa zlum po khrag mtsho'i dbus nas cung zad steng du thon pa ste/ de yang dper na ka to ra'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal gcig bzhag /ka to ra'i ri dang maṇ+ḍal gyi bar chus gang ba dang 'dra'o/ / rin po che'i ri bo de'i steng du thod pa skam po'i rwa ba zlum po/ rgya che ba sgo gcig pa keng rus kyi ka gdung thog phub pa dang ldan zhing*/ g.yang bzhi'i bla bre/ rgyu ma rlon pa'i lda ldi can/ stegs dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mo rdo rje nor bu tog gis brgyan pa/ zhes gsungs te/ 'di la nor bu'i dbyibs kho na sgom pa dang*/ nor bu'i steng du rdo rje'i rnam pa gnyis te/ gang sgom kyang rung bar 'gyur ro/ / 'dir kha gcig khrag mtsho dang thod rwa mi 'thad gsung bar 'dug kyang khrag mtsho ni ro sna tshogs pa'i khrag dbus su 'dus pa las byung zhing rgyud nas kyang bshad de/ rtog bdun las/ dkyil 'khor gyi grwa bzhir khrag gi chag chag gdab/ ces gsung pa 'di'i don no/ /spyir khrag mtsho dang thod rwa ni dur khrod kyi khongs su gtogs shing ro sna tshogs pa 'dus pa las de dag 'byung ba shugs las grub pa yin no/ /yang pha rgyud ma rgyud dur khrod yod med la brtags pa dag kyang byung mod/ de lta bu'ang mi 'thad de/ rdo rje 'jigs byed pha rgyud yin pa ni kun gyi shes la/ dur khrod 'bri ba ni/ rtog bdun gyi bri sku'i rtog pa'i skabs su gsungs yod do/ /gang ltar na'ang rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang 'gram nas khrag mtsho'i bar gyi phyogs bzhi/ mtshams bzhir dur khraud chen po brgyad mthong ba dang*/ gtam thos pa tsam gyis skyi g.ya' ba/ 'jigs pa dag kyang 'jigs par byed pa ste so so'i ming ni bcu gsum ma'i nang ltar brjod par bya'o/

/de dag rnams su me tog 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas pa/ ljon shing chen po brgyad de/ so so'i ming ni gshed dmar nas brgyud pa nyid do/ /brgya byin sogs phyogs skyong brgyad ni spyi dang mthun/ zhing skyong ba brgyad ni/ lha'i dge 'dun dkar po glang po che'i gdong can sogs so/ /chu brgyad ni rje rigs la sogs pa chu brgyad do/ /me brgyad la kha gcig bsil bar byed pa tsan+dan gyi me zhes sogs zer de/ rtog pas btags par zad do/ /ri brgyad ni/ ma la sogs so/ /mchod rten brgyad ni/ 'dus byas 'dus ma sogs klu brgyad/ sprin brgyad de dag ni grangs nges pa yin la/ gzhan yang ro dang*/ keng rus dang*/ ma mo dang*/ srin po dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ sha za dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ ro langs la sogs dpag tu med pa lang long du rgyu zhing*/ ha ha zhes pa'i sgra dang*/ ku co chen po rnams grags/ phan tshun la 'thab cing lhang lhang por 'bod pa dang*/ ro mdung la bskyon pa/ shing brag la dpyang pa/ mes tshig pa/ mgo bo med pa'i ros gar byed pa/ sha rus lpags pa rnams dum bur dum bur 'dug pas khyab pa/ khrag dang klad pa phyogs thams cad du 'thor ba dang*/ bya dang gcan gzan gdug pa can sna tshogs lang long du rgyu zhing 'khrugs pa dang*/ 'byung po sna tshogs kyi spyod pas yid bsgyur ba dngos grub kyi rdzas dang*/ yo byad dang mchod pa'i rdzas du mas yongs su gdams pa/ sa bcu'i sar gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub sgrub par byed pa rnams dang*/ grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa du ma dang*/ thod pa'i rnga thogs te gar byed pa'o/ /'di yan gyis rten gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa bskyed pa sogs zhing sbyong gzhal yas khang dur khrod dang bcas pa 'dis/ sbyang bya ni gang du skye ba len pa'i gnas sbyong zhing rnam par dag par skye ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs/ rdzogs rim gyi smin byed 'ja' lus myur du dka' ba med par 'byung ngo*/

/gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sa bon phyag mtshan tshul gyi bskyed pa dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhing sbyong rnam pa gsum gyis sgo nas bskyed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thod pa'i rwa ba yangs shing rgya che ba de nyid kyi nang du/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zlum po/ thod ra'i nang gi 'og gzhi dang rgya mnyam pa/ de'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa/ yal ga rlung gis dkyil 'khor dang tshad mnyam pa/ lte ba'i ze'u 'bru'i steng du raṃḥ yig zhu ba las nyi dkyil rgya tshad pad+ma lte ba dang mnyam pa 'od zer tsha ba rtsub pa dpag tu med pa 'phro ba ni 'jigs byed kyi dngos gdan bskyed pa yin cing*/ de'i steng du aḥ yig zhu ba las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor reg bya bsil ba 'jam pa'i 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba ni/ 'jam dpal kho na'i gdan te nyi ma las rgya cung zad chung ba'i steng du dhīḥ yig dmar ser zhu ba las ral gri sngo sangs rin po che'i yu ba sbubs stong gi nang du zla ba'i gdan la/ dhīḥ yig gnas pa ral gri de yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jal dpal gzhon nu gur gum gzhon nu'i me tog rgyas pa lta bu dmar ser phyag g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri dpung pa'i steng du 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i sdong po'i rtsa ba thugs kar mtheb mdzub kyis 'dzin cing*/ snyan gyi thad kar me tog kha phye ba'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bsnams pa rab tu zhi ba'i sgeg pa dang bcas pa rin po che'i dbu rgyan snyan rgyan mgul rgyan/ phyag gdub zhabs gdub sor gdub do shal sogs kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dpe rdzogs pa bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra'i thor tshugs lnga ste/ de yang dbu gtsug tu gcig /de'i g.yas g.yon dang mdun rgyab tu re re ste lnga dang ldan pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/

/gnyis pa ni/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ mthing nag las 'od zer sna lnga 'phros pa'i phyogs bcu'i zhing na de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga rnam snang sogs dang*/ gshegs ma yum bzhi ste spyan ma sogs dang*/ sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs sa snying nam snying sogs dang*/ rig ma sgra rdo rje ma sogs dang*/ khro bo bgegs mthar byed nas gnod mdzes kyi bar te/ spyir 'di dag gi rigs rnams bgrang ba las 'das mod/ mtshon byed du de ltar brjod pa'o/ /de thams cad 'jam dpal la thim zhing*/ 'jam dpal zla ba dang bcas pa yang nyi gdan la thim pas tsha zer lhag par 'bar ba dpag tshad 'bum du khyab pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis ā li kā li rtsa sngags snying po nye snying rnams/ 'brug sgra lta bu'i rang rang gi sgra dang bcas te mkha' dbyings gang bar byon pa rnams nyi ma'i steng du gcig tu 'dus pa las chos dbyings ye shes kyi rang bzhin hūṃ yig nag po ye shes lnga po 'od zer kha dog sna lnga'i tshul du 'phro bar gyur/ de'i 'od zer gyi ngo bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs ye shes chen po rnam pa ral gri gri gug sogs phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byon te hūṃ la thim pas/ de nyid rdo rje mthing nag rtse lnga pa rwa cung zad gdengs pa 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'bar ba ste/ kha cig rdo rje rtse dgu kho na sgom pa 'thad zer kyang*/ 'gal ba med pas gang bsgoms kyang chog pa ni yin mod/ 'on kyang 'dir ni rdo rje rtse lnga pa bstan pa yin no/ /de las gong du bstan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang*/ rdo rje phra mo nam mkha' la char 'bab pa ltar spros pas/ sdang ba'i dgra gdug pa can gyi bgegs sogs gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad de dag gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la bkod/ ma dag pa'i snod thams cad dag pa'i zhing du gyur cing de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang*/ rdo rje phra mo rnams dang*/
khyad par 'jam dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa spyan drangs/ de thams cad gcig tu gyur pa las/ zhes pa ste/ 'di'i skabs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dang rdo rje bsdu pa'i phyag rgya sogs mi dgos yid kyis spyan 'dren pa yin no/ /de yang zhing sbyong gsum la/ gong 'jam dpal gdan byas bstim pa spyi 'gror bzhugs nas/ phyi ma hūṃ dang rdo rje dang gcig tu gyur pa las zhes pa rnams la ngos 'dzin pa dang*/ yang na tsha zer ba zhes sogs sku'i zhing sbyong ngo*/ /hūṃ dang gyur sogs gsung gi zhing sbyong*/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa sogs thugs kyi zhing sbyong*/ zhes lugs gnyis yod pa las/ 'gal ba med cing 'dam ga yin kyang*/ dkyus kyi dbang du byas na phyi ma 'thad par mngon no/ /dag pa dran par byed pa ni nyi ma dang pad+mas gang du skye ba'i grong sbyong bar byed/ rlung dkyil dang zla bas ni rang nyid gdos bcas kyi lus dang yid ldan zhing*/ bar do'i lus kyang ma grub pa'i bar gyi rlung sems phra mo de sbyong ba dang*/ dhīḥ bsgom pa ni/ gsung gi rang bzhin te bar do'i ngag sbyong ba dang*/ ral gri ni thugs te bar do'i yid sbyong ba dang*/ 'jam dpal rgyus ni bar dos lus dbang po kun tshang ba las kyi rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa de sbyong ba dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob par byed pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi smin byed sems dben dang*/ sgyu lus dang zung 'jug gi sku myur du thob par byed pa'o/ /'jam dpal zla ba dang bcas pa nyi ma la thim pa ni/ 'jam dpal ni bar do'i lus zla ba'i khams nyi ma'i rdul de de gnyis kyi bar du yid lus de brgyal thabs su gnas pa de dag sbyong bar byed do/ /de yang rang bur skyes na pha la sdang sems dang ma la chags sems dang ldan pas 'jug la/ bu mor skyes na ma la sdang sems dang pha la chags sems dang bcas te 'jug go /de yang pha'i kha sgo nas zhugs/ khams dang bsdongs nas ma'i mngal du 'pho ste/ nur nur po dang*/ mer mer po dang*/ tar tar po sogs hūṃ dang rdo rje bsgoms pas sbyong ngo*/

/rdo rje de las de bzhin gshegs pa sogs dang*/ rdo rje phra mo'i spro ba'i mer mer po sogs de dag sas brtan pa dang*/ chus sdud pa dang*/ mes smin pa dang*/ rlung gis rul ba sogs mi 'byung bar rgyas par byed pa dang*/ nam mkha'i de dag gi go 'byed par byed pa de dag sbyong bar byed do/ /de nas ma'i mngal du zla dgu ngo bcu sogs lon te mngal ni btsas pa de'i lus skye bo kun gyis mthong ba ste rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi skus sbyong ste/ de yang sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin lta bur rab tu gnag la mun pa lta bur ngam za ba/ rtsa zhal ma he nag po rab tu khros pa/ rwa sngo sangs las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i mes phyogs thams cad zil gyis gnon pa/ de nas zhal dgu ni skyo lugs sogs steng zhal gnyis ma gtogs 'khor zhal du sgom pa dang kha cig 'bab 'khor zhal la/ g.yas zhal gsum lta bu/ rtsa zhal gyi rna ba'i ltag dang ltag pa gnyis kyang*/ dbus su sngon po g.yas su dmar po/ g.yon du ser po/ de bzhin du g.yon zhal la'ang sbyar zhing*/ srin zhal lta bu dang 'jam dpal brtsegs mar sgom pa sogs 'dug kyang*/ 'dir rwa lugs ni lugs gnyis yod pa la/ rnam pa gcig tu na g.yas kyi zhal rnams g.yas rwa'i logs la brtsegs mar yod pa dang*/ g.yon zhal rnams g.yon rwa'i logs la brtsegs mar sgom pa zhig rdzogs rim gyi skabs su yod pa dang*/ bskyed rim rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la brtsegs zhal kho na sgom pa yin te/ de yang ma he'i zhal gyi snyan gyi ltag tu shin tu khros pa'i zhal sngon po dmar po ser po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa dang*/ g.yon du g.yas zhal las cung zad zhi ba'i zhal dkar po dud kha nag po rnams brtsegs pa dang*/ rwa gnyis kyi dbus su srin po lta bu'i zhal shin tu dmar ba zhal gdangs shing ljags 'gril ba/ mche ba rab tu gtsigs pa/ ha ha pheṃ pheṃ zhes drag tu bzhad pa/ zhal gyi 'gram nas khrag 'dzag pa/

dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ shin tu khros la chags pa'i nyams cung zad dang yang ldan pa/ de'i steng du 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i zhal gser btso ma lta bu khro zhing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa zur phud lnga pa/ byis pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum pa'o/ /skabs 'ga' zhig tu 'jam dpal gyi zhal mgrin pa dang bcas sgom gsung ba dag kyang yod de/ sngon gyi ras bris sogs na dbu brtsegs pa kho na snang bas de ltar bya ste/ snga ma yang 'gal bar gyur pa ni ma yin no/ khro zhal brgyad po rnams ni ha ha hi hi zhes sogs rdo rje'i gad mo dang*/ hūṃ phaṭa kyi sgras stong chen po'i 'jig rten khyab pas dgra dang*/ bgegs kyi sha dang*/ rkang dang*/ tshil sogs zhal du gsol ba/ zhal ras rnam par 'gyur ba khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa smin ma 'khyog por gcus pa/ skra ser gyen du 'bar ba/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gsum po rnams sdang mig gis lta zhing myur du bzlogs pa/ me rtag lta bu rno zhing tsha ba rtsub pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i smin rdzi dang sma ra dang ba spu can/ 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das pa dang ma 'das lha thams cad la rab tu bsd-igs pa/ zhal brgyad po rab tu rno bas mche ba bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa/ ljags 'gril ba tshams rngam gyi sgra 'brug stong dus gcig tu ldir pa'am bskal pa 'jig pa'i rlung gi sgra lta bu bdud kyi sde'i snying 'gas par byed pa/ lang tsho la bab pa sku las sprul pa'i pho nya gdong sna tshogs dang ldan zhing*/ phyag mtshan sna tshogs thogs pa/ mdog sna tshogs su 'dug pa dpag tu med pa spro zhing sdud pa/ sku las shin tu che ba/ yan lag nying lag rnams sbom zhing thung ba hrag pa 'khregs bag dang ldan pa/ gsus khyims che ba/ liṅka rab tu rgyas pa gyen du bsgreng ba'o/ /phyag gsum cu rtsa bzhi'i dang po gnyis zhes pa nas/ glang lpags kyi bar sgrub thabs ltar bskyed pa las/ phyag mtshan 'phang mdung ni rtse mtshon gyi rnam pa mdung so lta bu la/

mjug tu rma bya'i sgro phod yod pa zhig yin la/ gtun shing ni shing sbom thung sked pa shin tu phra ba zhig dang*/ rdo rje rtse gcig ni ka na ya zhes zer te/ shing 'dom gang tsam gyi rtse gnyis po 'khor lo re re/ shing rtse dang 'khor lo dag las 'thon pa'i mtshon mdung so'i dbyibs can/ shin tu rno ba mtho gang tsam re yod pa zhig go /dbyug pa ni rdo rjes mtshan pa'o/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ni mgo bo rnam pa gsum brtsegs par yod pa ste spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'khor lo ni rtsibs brgyad dam drug dang ldan pa'i mtshon pa'i 'khor lo ngar dang ldan pa'o/ /rnge'u chung ni ḍā ma ru'o/ /mgo bo ni bdud kyi ste rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa zhig go /me thab ni zur gsum pa'o/ /thod tshal ni mi'i mgo bo dum bu sha lpags skra dang bcas pa nang bdud rtsis gang ba ste/ sngags pa rnams kyi ban+dha zer ba 'di lta bu yin par mngon no/ /sdigs mdzub ni/ kha cig mi lag sdigs mdzub can zhig phyag gis bzung ba yin zer kyang*/ rang lugs phyag gis sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /ba dan ni 'phan rtse gsum pa'o/ /rlung ras ni kha dog ljang gu rlung gi rang bzhin can bskyod pa zhig go /tha ma gnyis kyis ni glang lpags rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa sku stod kyi phyogs su phyar te sku la ma 'byar ba stod g.yogs kyi tshul du 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan rnams go sla'o/ /la li ta dang*/ a mo gha/ slob dpon a bo sogs kyis dang po'i phyag gis glang lpags 'dzin par gsungs pa ni/ rgyab kyi phyag nas brtsam ste bsgrigs par mngon la dang po yin tshad rtsa phyag yin pa'i nges pa med do/ / 'dir ni rtsa phyag nas brtsam ste bshad pa'o/ /zhabs rnams bris thang sogs la brgyad brkyang bskum dang*/ brgyad gar stabs su byas pa yod pa'ang 'dug kyang de dag ni stabs ma bde ba'i phyir de ltar byas pa yin la/ sgom pa'i skabs su g.yas brgyad bskum zhing g.yon brgyad lhag par brkyang ba sgom pa'o/

/de yang g.yas kyi zhabs re res mi nas/ wa'i bar te gdon brgyad kyi ngo bo yin la gdon brgyad ni phyogs skyong ba brgyad do/ /g.yon rnams kyi bya rgod nas/ bzhad kyi bar ni nad brgyad kyi ngo bo ste/ bzhad ni bod du mi 'byung ngo*/ /de rnams kyi 'og tu bdud bzhi gdong drug la sogs pa rnams kha sbub tu bsgyel nas mnan pa/ sku gcer bu shin tu gtum pa zhal brgyad la thod pa lnga lngas brgyan pa/ sprul nag dang mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu rgyu rlon la brgyus te do shal byas pa/ 'khor lo'i snyan rgyan sogs rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ bskal ba 'jig par nus pa'i me lta bu'i klong nas bzhugs pa 'dod pa'i khams dang*/ gzugs khams dang gzugs med khams rnams kyi blta bar yang mi bzod pa'i dam tshig sems dpa' nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /'di ltar sku yongs rdzogs kyi dag pa ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa sgrol ba'i mgon po'i mdzad par blta zhing sems par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du ye shes sems dpa' bstims/ gzhi 'jam dpal sku mdog sogs rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa lta bu dang*/ spro na de'i thugs kar rdo rje nag po rtse dgu pa'i rtse lnga pa'i nang du nyi dkyil gyi steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ nag po bsgom zhing bsdus na hūṃ kho na bsgom mo/ /de nas skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa na/ thal thams cad la sbyor ba byung mod/ rang lugs ni rtsa zhal kho na'i mig g.yas g.yon gyi dbus su k+ṣiṃ dkar po kha phyir bstan pa 'od zer 'phro ba ste/ sa snying dngos kyi 'du shes dang*/ de bzhin du rna ba gnyis kyis khung bur dz+riṃḥsngon po phyag na rdo rje sogs thams cad la 'gres so/ /sna bug gis rtse'i nang ngam 'dom so la khaṃ ser po nam mkha'i snying po dang*/

lce rtsar gaṃ dmar po 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ dpral ba'i mthong sam skra mtshams su skaṃ ljang khu sgrib sel dang*/ lte bar saṃ dkar po kun tu bzang po ste/ kun rdzob tu sbyar na dpral ba dang lte ba'i 'di sha lpags mtshams su sgom par byed kyang*/ lha sku ni gdos byed dang bral ba'i tshad gzhal bar bya mi dgos so/ /spyi bo'i dbus su oṃ dkar po sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje/ mgrin pa'i dbus su āḥ dmar po gsung rdo rje/ snying kha'i dbus su hūṃ nag po thugs rdo rje ste/ de gsum yang yi ge gsum 'dus pa ste/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ngo bo'o/ /hūṃ de las 'od zer mkha' dbyings khyab par spros pas/ gdod ma ni grub pa 'og min gyi gnas nas rdo rje 'jigs byed sangs rgyas byang chub dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs nas mchod pa lnga phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod cing snying kha nas mchod tshogs dpag tu med pa spro'o/ /de nas/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /ces dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad/ bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /zhes gtso bo la bos te/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba btab pas/ dbang lha rigs lngas dbang bskur/ gshegs ma bzhis khrus gsol/ sems dpa' drug gam brgyad kyis shis pa brjod cing me tog gi char dang*/ rol mo'i sgra bsgrag /gzugs rdo rje ma sogs kyis yang dag par mchod/ khro bo khro mos bgegs thams cad bskrad cing*/ sangs rgyas rnams ni sogs gsung zhing dbang bskur ba ste/ de'i don ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba las byung gzugs gzugs med 'dod khams te khams gsum gyis phyag byas pa'i dbang de khyod la dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /zhes so/ /oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta zhes sogs gsung zhing ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur lus thams cad gang*/

rdo rje khro bo'i mthu stobs thams cad la dbang bar byas/ sdig sgrib thams cad yang dag par sbyangs te/ chu'i dwangs ma yar lud nas/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor 'khyil ba la/ mi bskyod par gyur nas dbu rgyan gyur par bsam mo/ /de ltar dbang bskur ba'i las ye shes pa de nyid kyis mdzad zin pa na/ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ zhes phyag dang bcas pas mdun du byon par bsam/ de bzhin du pa sha zhes pa'i lus la gzhugs/ spo ṭa zhes pa'i dam ye 'bral med du bcings/ gaṇ+ḍe zhes pas mnyes par byed pa ste/ dgug gzhug kyang mi mnyes bzhin du ma yin gyi mnyes pa dang bcas pas so/ /de nas sngar sems dpa' gsum brtsegs bsgoms pa med na skabs 'dir nges par gsal 'debs dgos la/ sngar yod na sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i yig 'bru dmigs bcas dran pa tsam gyis kyang chog ste/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtugs te/ hrīḥ ṣ+tiḥ re re brjod do/ /dag pa ni/ ma'i mngal nas btsas te skye bo kun gyis mthong ba'i lus de ni bcom ldan 'das kyi skus sbyong zhing*/ sprul pa'i sku thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa dang*/ smin byed zung 'jug kha sbyor myur du thob pa dang*/ skye mched gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi lus cher song zhing khams rgyas pa'i skabs sbyong*/ rgyas btab kyi rang rigs kyi byed las rnams sbyong bar byed do/ /de nas bdag nyid la mchod par bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas gzugs rdo rje ma sogs lnga dang*/ sgeg mo lha mo brgyad spros nas rang nyid la mchod par bsam ste/ sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin dang bcas pa bya'o/ /de nas gzugs sgra la sogs pa ngag tu brjod de/ de'i don ni/ gzugs sgra sogs kyi mchod par 'dug kyang*/ dngos 'dzin med cing nam mkha' lta bu yin kyang*/ longs spyod kyi rnam grangs du mar snang ste/ dper na tshon sna lnga zhig gis steng du shel g.ya' dag pa dkar po zhig bzhag na/

de tshon mdog ji bzhin du snang ba lta bu'i 'dod yon de dang de la rtag tu spyod par shog /a la la hoḥ zhes ngo mtshar ba'i tshig dang*/ mchod pa 'di dag la rol zhing longs spyod du gsol/ zhes pa ste/ de yang mchod pa de dag 'dzin pa med pa sgyu ma lta bu/ dbang yul du 'gag pa med par rig pa/ don dam par mig yor lta bu de la rol te hoḥ zhes chags tshig gis bskul ni/ don dam par chags pa dang bral yang rnam par chags par mdzod/ oṃ sarba sogs/ ko3 haṃ gi bar te/ de'i don ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes sogs/ de ltar mchod nas lha mo rnams slar yang rang gi snying gar bsdus/ de nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rang nyid la bstod par bsams te/ dud khrod ces pa nas/ 'dud ces pa'i bar brjod do/ /de'i don ni dur khrod kyi rgyan gyi rab tu brgyan pa zhe sdang gshin rje gshed khyod ngo bo bde ba chen po spros pa dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu yin yang*/ thugs rje chen po'i 'gro ba'i don du sprul pa'i sku ye shes chen po'i khro bo rab tu khros pas/ sku mdog dud kha dang mun pa lta bu gnag cing ngam za ba khyod la 'dud/ ces pa ste/ oṃ sarba nas ko haṃ te de'i don ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bstod pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes so/ /de nas rjes chags kyi bde ba bsgom pa ni/ 'khyud rgya byas la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes yum rdo rje ro langs ma spros nas rang la 'khyud rdo rje pad+ma'i sbyor bas bde ba sgom par byed do/ /oṃ sarba nas/ ko3 haṃ ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rjes su chags pa'i rdo rje rang bzhin bdag nyid nga'o/ /swa bhā was sbyangs te/ mdun du rlung dkyil zla gam bcad kha rang la bstan cing*/ chang zung g.yo ba'i ba dan can/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/

de'i steng du kaṃ gsum yongs su gyur pa las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyis steng du thod pa shin tu rgya che ba dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i sa bon na las mi'i sha ya yig gis mtshan pa sogs te/ ya ni gshin rje gshed/ k+ṣe ni gti mug gshin rje gshed/ ma ni ser sna gshin rje gshed/ me 'dod chags gshin rje gshed/ dha phrag dog gshin rje gshed/ dbus kyi steng du shu las byang sems hūṃ gis mtshan pa sogs te/ hūṃ ni rdo rje ro langs ma/ dza ni tsartsi ka /sa ni phag mo/ do ni dbyangs can ma/ ru ni gau ri ti/ rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa'i sa bon no/ /rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros rlung g.yos mes sbar te sha bdud rtsi yi ge rnams zhu zhing khol te/ spris ma sna tshogs rdo rje'i tshul du gyur pa'i lte bar zhe sdang gshin rje gshed nag po'am sngon po/ de bzhin du shar gyi dkar po/ lhor ser po/ nub tu dmar po/ byang du ljang khu rnams yin la/ de nas rgya mtsho chen por gyur ces pa'i bar bsam zhing brjod pa ste/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs nang mchod dngos su yod na myang*/ med na dmigs pa'i rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed dngos yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal brtan pa dang*/ phyag rnams byang phyogs so bdun/ zhabs stong nyid bcu drug sogs sku'i dag pa dran par byed pa'o/ /de yang lha sku snang ba de lta bus/ rang lus mgo gcig lag pa gnyis pa'i snang ba 'di sbyong ba dang*/ nga rgyal brtan pos bdag tu zhen pa sbyong bar byed do/ /rtsa ba'i gsum pa rjes ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum gyi snod thams cad gzhal yas khang dang*/ bcud thams cad lha'i rang bzhin du bya ste/ thams cad bdag gis sgom pa'i bsrung 'khor la thim/ bsrung 'khor dur khraud khrag mtsho yang gzhal yas khang la thim/ rang gi zhal phyag lhag ma rnams kyang rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/
de yang 'od gsal du zhu bar bsam nas cung zad mnyam par bzhag

/'dis ni 'chi ba sbyong zhing chos sku thob pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa dang*/ des don gyi 'od gsal mngon du byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bsrung ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang de las slar yang rang nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis par krong g-is song ba'i mig tu k+ṣiṃ nas/ saṃ gis bar gong bzhin bsgoms pa ste/ smon lam ci rigs bkra shis dang bcas pa brjod pa'o/ /zhes pa rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyis sgrub thabs snying po'i 'bru non brjed tho zin bris mdo tsam 'di ni rdo rje 'chang chen po tā ra nā thas zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i dge slong rin chen rgya mtshos bgyis pa'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// dge'o// //'dir bzhengs rab dkar bsod nams kyis/ /'brel thogs yod tshad la phan te/ /gnas skabs mthar thug legs tshogs thob/ /ring min gtan bde dbang gyur cig/ // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 274 -- PAGE 273 -- PAGE 242 -
